correctness.rationale: Finite-plane identity BB^T=B^TB=(s mod 2)I+J and odd v split point/line coordinates into constants and sum-zero sectors. Odd s gives two J1(0) adjacency blocks and (v-1) J2(1); even s gives J2(1), 2(rho-1) J2(0) and residual J1(0). Reversible transfer (u,w)->(Au+w,u) maps these to temporal (X+1)^2, p(X)^2 and (X+1)^4 modules; polynomial gcd with X^t-1 yields E(t), Mobius inversion and sharp order. Independent Fano matrix computation checked rho=4, fixed dims [6,12,8,24,16,28] for t=[1,2,3,4,6,12], T^12=I. Extension-field module assertion remains valid although p may split over F_Q.
